commits.subject: fix(agent): fix auto-update version detection and script reliability
commits.body:
- Fix package.json path in version.ts (../../.. → ../..)
  The agent was unable to find CLI's package.json, causing getAgentVersion()
  to return '0.0.0' instead of the actual version

- Add 'cd /tmp' at start of update script to avoid blocking the agent
  directory during npm install (ENOTEMPTY error)

- Add chmod +x after npm install to fix executable permissions
  npm doesn't always preserve the executable bit on dist/index.js

@@ -88,6 +88,9 @@ export function triggerUpdate(targetVersion: string): void {
 # 247 Auto-Update Script
 # Target version: ${targetVersion}
 
+# Change to /tmp to avoid blocking the agent directory during npm install
+cd /tmp
+
 # Wait for agent to fully exit
 sleep 2
 
@@ -98,6 +101,13 @@ if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
   echo "[247] npm install failed, attempting restart anyway..."
 fi
 
+# Fix executable permissions (npm doesn't always preserve them)
+CLI_BIN="$(npm root -g)/${PACKAGE_NAME}/dist/index.js"
+if [ -f "$CLI_BIN" ]; then
+  chmod +x "$CLI_BIN"
+  echo "[247] Fixed executable permissions"
+fi
+
 echo "[247] Updating hooks..."
 247 hooks update || true

commits.subject: feat: replace hooks with heartbeat system and persist StatusLine metrics
commits.body:
BREAKING CHANGE: Remove old hooks-based status notification system

New heartbeat-based architecture:
- Add heartbeat endpoint that receives Claude Code statusLine updates (~300ms)
- Add heartbeat-monitor for timeout detection (3s → idle)
- Add setup-statusline.ts to configure Claude Code statusLine
- Persist StatusLine metrics in SQLite (model, cost, context, lines)
- Metrics survive page refresh via DB fallback

Frontend improvements:
- Display metrics in MinimalSessionHeader (model, cost, context %)
- Keep lines changed (+/-) on SessionModule cards
- Add notification debouncing (30s between notifications)

Database migration v3→v4:
- Add model, cost_usd, context_usage, lines_added, lines_removed columns
- Automatic migration on agent startup

Removed:
- packages/hooks/ (old bash-based notification scripts)
- routes/hooks.ts (replaced by routes/heartbeat.ts)
- Complex hook installation in CLI

commits.subject: fix(agent): improve status mapping and prevent ghost sessions
commits.body:
- Validate tmux session exists before accepting heartbeats (prevents ghost sessions)
- Re-inject CLAUDE_TMUX_SESSION for existing sessions (fixes INIT stuck status)
- Change heartbeat timeout to transition to 'idle' instead of 'needs_attention'
- Add comprehensive tests for all changes

The status mapping is now:
- working: heartbeat active
- idle: no heartbeat for 3s (no notification)
- needs_attention: only when Claude explicitly needs user input
